title: 熱力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Thermodynamics I
keywords: Temperature and heat 2.Thermal equilibrium 3.Ideal gas 4.The first law of thermodynamics 5.Regional collaboration
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn basic knowledge of the irreversibility in the nature world (2) Learn how to convert energy and obtain work from heat (3) Acquire design skills for energy conversion in mechanical engineering
advice: This is a basic course in thermodynamics. We will cover the following topics: 1. Definitions of heat, temperature and systems 2. Thermal equilibrium and the zeroth law of thermodynamics 3. Thermal properties of mixed gases 4. Equation of state of ideal gases 5. The first law of thermodynamics Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas. Students are expected to solve exercises independently. Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedules of lectures, quizzes, tests, and reports may change as the class progresses. Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts. Detailed schedules and content of the course are explained in the first class.
books: Textbook : Koguchi et al., Thermodynamics (in Japanese), Asakura shoten. Reference book : Thermodynamics(in Japanese), JSME Textbook Series, JSME Reserved books : Problems in Thermodynamics(in Japanese), JSME Textbook Series, JSME
requiredKnowledge: Have sufficient skill in mathematics (especially differential and integral calculations). Familiarize yourself with how to use a scientific calculator.
